Messages.Author: Matthew E Strehlow
Messages.Body:
Is Scorpion Sting a hand strike?

What I really need to know is, does Wolf Claws or Claws of the Dead make
the strike from Scorpion Sting aggravated?

If this is the case are all Strike: + X hand damage considered hand
strikes?

Thanks,
~Matt Strehlow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Matthew E Strehlow wrote:
>
> Is Scorpion Sting a hand strike?

Yes.

* Hand Strike: any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals damage based
on the striking minion's hand damage, or any minion's non-ranged
damage-dealing innate strike. [LSJ 19970224]

> What I really need to know is, does Wolf Claws or Claws of the Dead make
> the strike from Scorpion Sting aggravated?

Yes.

> If this is the case are all Strike: + X hand damage considered hand
> strikes?

If they don't involve weapons (and aren't ranged), yes.
